description:

reviews_5s: This cheesecloth is a nice large size for draining potatoes for latkes. It’s easy to use and good quality for a small price.I just received the cheese cloth and was confused that it seemed to be only 36 inches square instead of the 36x72 (2 square yards) statement on the product information. Then I went back and looked at the edges closely. There was another fold that, once opened, turned the cloth into 2 yards x 36 inches. I had to laugh at myself. Yes, other reviews have mentioned the thickness/ thinness of the weave but that is no problem with me. I bought the cloth to use in my fiber art pieces, to layer over cloth scraps, ribbons and embellish with stitches and odd items. It will work nicely!Good amount.and I’ve washed it twice so far. I do put it into a fine wash bag when I wash itHave used this product for years and it maintains its expectations. I’ll continue buying it.Product performed well, at a great price. Will buy againItem as described! Fast shipping!Bought this specifically because unbleached cheesecloth. I was not sure how much 2 yds meant when it came to wrapping and curing fruitcakes having never made and no recipes indicated. Well the answer is you need 2 yds for each fruit cake! So I ran out to my hardware store for similar:)Love that these are naturalGreat products and it works well. :)As described
